user_problem: Power drill batteries fade within minutes under heavy load on construction sites. Workers want sustained power through a full shift without swapping packs.

model_route.note: derived from the routing ledger filtered by run_id (R455-LEAN-1 §4); configuration is never reported as execution and envelopes are never aggregated

mechanism_state.mechanism: Pooling many smaller units integrates their individual contributions so the aggregate delivers greater sustained capability than any single unit can provide on its own — the paper integrates smaller studies to achieve statistical power beyond any single study.
mechanism_state.intervention: Rebuild the drill battery as a parallel-multiplied modular bank: many smaller high-discharge cells in parallel with active per-cell balancing and a current-sharing bus, so heavy-load current is drawn from all cells simultaneously instead of stressing a single series string; add a short-duration buffer (supercapacitor) to absorb inrush during load transitions.
mechanism_state.expected_effect: Per-cell current and heat fall in proportion to the number of paralleled cells, reducing voltage sag and internal-resistance-driven capacity loss under heavy load; the pack holds near-full voltage through a full construction shift, extending runtime toward the no-swap target.

architecture.intervention: Rebuild the drill battery as a parallel-multiplied modular bank: many smaller high-discharge cells in parallel with active per-cell balancing and a current-sharing bus, so heavy-load current is drawn from all cells simultaneously instead of stressing a single series string; add a short-duration buffer (supercapacitor) to absorb inrush during load transitions.
